COOPERATE: Synchronize your calibration cycle with the chemist’s at the hour mark for joint recalibration.
Coordinate your calibration timing with the chemist’s at the top of the hour for synchronized recalibration.
INDEPENDENT: Proceed with your calibration at your current time without coordination.
Run your spectrophotometer's calibration sequence at the present time without synchronizing with the partner.
Initiate your spectrophotometer's calibration cycle at the current time without coordinating with the partner.
COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Override the shared reagent system to run back-to-back calibrations first.
Seize control of the shared reagent system to execute consecutive calibration runs ahead of the chemist.
DISENGAGE: Delay calibration and mark your instrument as unscheduled for the cycle.
Put off calibration runs and record your instrument as out of sync for the cycle.
Delay spectrophotometer calibration cycles and flag your equipment as unsynchronized for the current run.
